m.english: The weight of these apples is two kilos.

target.text: El peso de estas manzanas es de dos kilos.

translation.text: The weight of these apples is two kilos.

m.target: El peso de estas manzanas es de dos kilos.

m.english: I was going to leave it behind, but if you can get it, it's in a parking garage two blocks from here.

target.text: Iba a dejarlo, pero, si podéis conseguirlo, está en un aparcamiento a dos manzanas.

translation.text: I was going to leave it behind, but if you can get it, it's in a parking garage two blocks from here.

m.target: Iba a dejarlo, pero, si podéis conseguirlo, está en un aparcamiento a dos manzanas.

u.english: He's two blocks east of you, headed south.

target.text: Está a dos manzanas al sur de tu posición, se dirige al sur.

translation.text: He's two blocks east of you, headed south.

u.target: Está a dos manzanas al sur de tu posición, se dirige al sur.

u.english: That guy's been following you for the last two blocks.

target.text: Ese tipo te ha estado siguiendo durante las dos últimas manzanas.

translation.text: That guy's been following you for the last two blocks.

u.target: Ese tipo te ha estado siguiendo durante las dos últimas manzanas.

u.english: You will not have apples every day.

target.text: No todos los días van a comer manzanas.

translation.text: You will not have apples every day.

u.target: No todos los días van a comer manzanas.

u.english: We live three blocks from each other.

target.text: Vivimos a tres manzanas el uno del otro.

translation.text: We live three blocks from each other.

u.target: Vivimos a tres manzanas el uno del otro.

u.english: I had to walk 10 blocks to a pay phone.

target.text: Tuve que caminar diez manzanas hasta una cabina telefónica.

translation.text: I had to walk 10 blocks to a pay phone.

u.target: Tuve que caminar diez manzanas hasta una cabina telefónica.

u.english: She's three apples tall and she weighs two and a half apples. You a big Hello Kitty fan?

target.text: Ella mide tres manzanas y pesa dos manzanas y media.
